name: sg_domain_authenticate
description: Authenticate a domain (create a domain whitelabel). Domain authentication signs mail with DKIM and sets the SPF record; the new domain starts unvalidated until its DNS records are verified. (POST /v3/whitelabel/domains)

subdomain.description: The subdomain to use for this authenticated domain, e.g. em1234.

username.description: The username associated with this domain.

custom_spf.description: Specify whether to use a custom SPF record or the default SPF.

default.description: Whether to use this authenticated domain as the fallback if no authenticated domains match the sender's domain.

automatic_security.description: Whether to allow SendGrid to manage your SPF records, DKIM keys, and DKIM key rotation.
